BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present No. 1 Lagan House to the Dublin City Centre property market.

Presented in excellent decorative condition throughout, this spacious two-bedroom apartment extends to approximately 721 sq. ft. and offers well-proportioned accommodation comprising a large open-plan living/dining room, a fully fitted kitchen, two double bedrooms, a master bedroom with en-suite bathroom, a family bathroom, and a convenient storage area.

The property further benefits from a private balcony overlooking Mayor Street and a secure designated parking space.

Ideally situated in the heart of the IFSC, residents can enjoy an exceptional range of cafés, restaurants, shops, and amenities right on their doorstep. The area is home to many leading financial institutions and multinational companies, making it one of Dublin's most sought-after city-centre locations.

The apartment is within walking distance of Dublin's principal retail, business, and leisure districts, including Grafton Street, O'Connell Street, and Grand Canal Dock. Excellent transport links are available nearby, including the LUAS Red Line at Mayor Square, numerous Dublin Bus routes, Connolly Station, and Busáras, ensuring easy access to all parts of the city and beyond.

This superb property is sure to appeal to both owner-occupiers seeking a stylish city residence and investors looking for a strong investment opportunity in a prime location.

Early viewing is highly recommended. Contact Dixon Residential Estate Agents today to arrange a viewing.
